clock_reconstruction.reason: The captured logs do not store a paired browser timestamp for each /phase request or a Node/browser clock handshake. The first phase is only a coarse anchor; its request delay and absolute clock offset cannot be separated.

context_from_v3.study: native localhost TURN/TCP action assay V3
context_from_v3.use: separate context only; no pooling or replication claim

interpretation: This is a descriptive native UDP telemetry probe on one previously used source; the 20 sessions are one schedule-by-level cell each and are not an independent source panel.
The 0.65, 0.85, and 1.05 encoded-payload/BWE means use the same 1.8–2.6 s post-ack window as the separate TURN/TCP V3 report. They are not pooled and do not constitute a cross-transport replication.
The single unreceived presentation-feedback send is retained; no session or hold was excluded.
Relay packet history is replayed within its Node clock, but it is not joined to sender holds because absolute browser-to-Node clock alignment is uncalibrated.
No quality endpoint, controller, model, or synthetic result was evaluated or changed.
